name: Jokuaku Saimin 180 Byou ~Me ga Sametara Hishojo ni Natteita~
original_name: 濁悪催眠180秒 ～目が覚めたら非処女になっていた～
source: The protagonist is bullied, and comes into the possession of a book that details how to hypnotize people for three minutes. Obviously he puts this newfound ability to use against the girls that were bullying him.
